description: Checkmyguest offers you a magnificent 99 m² first-floor apartment in the sought-after Ternes district. This modern apartment features four elegant bedrooms, ideal for a family or business group. You'll be just a stone's throw from the iconic Arc de Triomphe, offering you an exceptional living environment.The spaceDiscover this sumptuous 99 m² apartment in the Ternes district, decorated in a modern, contemporary style and ideal for up to 10 people.The Ternes district is renowned for its dynamic ambience and friendly atmosphere. Located close to the Arc de Triomphe, this district offers a perfect blend of Parisian charm and modern amenities. The lively streets are packed with boutiques, cafés and restaurants, offering residents an exceptional urban living experience.The apartment is equipped to offer optimal comfort to its occupants:➜ A spacious living room with a sofa bed, ideal for relaxing after a day of sightseeing, offering a convivial space for getting together with family or friends.➜ Four bedrooms with four double beds, each carefully furnished to ensure restful, comfortable nights.➜ An elegant dining area for convivial meals, with a table large enough to accommodate all guests.➜ A fully equipped kitchen with hob, fridge, kettle and more, allowing you to prepare meals just like at home.➜ Two bathrooms with two showers and toilets, giving everyone a private space to freshen up and relax.➜ Separate toilets for added convenience and comfort for all occupants.➜ Numerous optimized storage spaces to organize your belongings.⇄ Television and high-speed Internet (WIFI).➜ Bed linen and towels are provided by us.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment, so you will feel at home.Other things to noteThis booking is protected with coverage for lost luggage and
